text: Great app, easy to use and good widgets that helps me keep on track with my habits (both habits I want to implement and those I want to break). Bonuspoints for the category feature where you can create your own categories and group your habits as you like: a habit can be linked to multiple categoroes making it very easy to track both by habit stack (eg "morning routine") and by overall purpose ("habits to improve X"). Worth every penny! :)
author: Saja Jansson
